summary: Laia's house have a secret inside. Find out in this intriguing game.
description:
A new family has arrived in Hidden Town, but since the day they moved in, they have been harassed by strange presences in their own home, until a few days later they disappeared without a trace. What happened? Where are they? Help Laia solve the mystery and reveal the secrets behind her disappearance.

Haunted Laia is the fifth episode of the Hidden Town escape room games series. In this point and click escape puzzle game, you must navigate through your memories to discover how you got to where you are and escape to rescue your family and return home.

The Dark Dome escape room games can be played in any order you like. They are all connected to each other in one way or another. Little by little all the mysteries of Hidden Town will be revealed. This horror escape mystery game has connections to The Ghost Case and Another Shadow

- What you will find in this suspense thriller game:

A lot of brain teasers and puzzles spread between Laia's house, the cave, and the room behind the red door.

An exciting and captivating detective story with an unforgettable protagonist.

A surprising graphic style that together with a deep soundtrack will completely immerse you in the horror mystery adventure.

An alternate achievement: Find all 10 lizards hidden throughout the entire escape puzzle game. Lizards can be very elusive and hard to find. Search every corner.

A very complete hint system. If you feel stuck in the suspense thriller game you can always turn to the hints to help you and continue with the detective story.

- Premium version:
By purchasing the Premium Version of this haunted house game you will be able to play an exclusive secret scene with a side story of Hidden Town that has additional riddles and puzzles. In addition, all the ads in the horror mystery game will be removed, so you can access all the hints directly without seeing ads.

- How to play this horror escape mystery game:
Interact with objects and characters in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects, use the inventory items on game objects or combine them to create a new item to help you continue on the suspense thriller adventure. Put your wits to the test and solve mystery case..

Solve Mystery Case: Piece Together the Puzzle of Terror
Put your detective skills to the test as you delve deep into the heart of the mystery case. Each clue you uncover leads you closer to the truth, but beware – not everything is as it seems in this suspense thriller. Can you solve the escape puzzle before the darkness consumes you?

“Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of the Dark Dome escape room games and reveal all its secrets. There are still many mysteries to be unraveled in Hidden Town."
